notes: This contract covers the bounded recipient-side Convey Region Designator Sets behavior in the embedded development profile. Regional overlap routing remains independent from callback metadata: the receiver's switch is re-evaluated at callback entry, disabled delivery omits the optional Set of Sent Region Designators argument, and enabled delivery carries the sent update-region realization for the receive-order and timestamped interaction/reflection paths exercised by Catch2. The explicit-source timestamped re-enable and Flush Queue companions confirm that this metadata remains attached to queued callbacks across their distinct time-management paths. Default-region realization, conveyed-region ownership/use, directed interactions, remote transport, save/restore, package evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice. The 2026-10-26 reviewed Lab backflow pin carries corrected source section labels; retired Umbra overrides are recorded in backflow_section_sync.
